shadowBoundary.rule: Shadow speciesId is recorded only when the pinned PvPoke data supports an exact Shadow identity; regional/Zen forms never synthesize a _shadow ID by naming convention.

notesZhTw: 第三批 PvP evidence 以固定 2026-09-01 PvPoke snapshot 與同 commit gamemaster 的 exact speciesId 為準。達摩狒狒普通模式、達摩模式、伽勒爾普通模式、伽勒爾達摩模式，以及伽勒爾哭哭面具、洗翠索羅亞／索羅亞克都分開映射；沒有 pinned Shadow identity 的 form 保持 null，不自行拼接名稱。
boundary: PvPoke presence is battle evidence only and never release evidence. The species-level guide must display ranks for the designated ordinary/default form and may mention special-form ranks only as explicitly isolated context.
